_doc: Tuning for scripts/ingest-business-info.ts — the business deep-info agent. It reads each place's official website from src/data/places-enrichment.json, extracts supported business facts, and deterministically preserves real menu, order, reservation, catering, and gift-card anchors. The model never constructs commerce URLs. This config controls which businesses to read and how often. typeIncludes/excludeDomains are substring matches. Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (repo secret) to run; the agent validates each fetch, falls back to a headless render when a site is JS-only, and never fabricates.
